content.what_it_is: MATLAB function Plot_1Dth (L1-2, signature continued with '...' onto L2) in the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence Spectrum_Generator_for_WKDATA2D toolset: plots the 1D directional spectrum in m2/rad (comment L3). Algorithm: extracts unique direction values theta_unique = unique(theta) (L4), mtheta = length(theta_unique) (L5), and allocates Syy1d_th = zeros(1,mtheta) (L6). A double loop over i,j = 1:mfreq (L9-16) counts repetitions of each frequency into reps(i) (L10 init to 0, L13 increment) under the section comment 'get the repetitions of each freq' (L8). A second double loop (L20-27) integrates the directional spectrum: for each unique direction j, sums Spectrum_Energy(i)*freq_resolution over all i with theta_unique(j)==theta(i) (L22) into Syy1d_th_unique(j) (L23, continuation '*freq_resolution' on L24). Computes Hmo_Syy1d_th = 4*sqrt(sum(Syy1d_th*pi)) (L28) rounded to 2 decimals (L29) — note this sums Syy1d_th, not Syy1d_th_unique. Plot section (L30): figure(12) (L31) plots Syy1d_th_unique vs theta_unique (L32), x-limits [-pi/2+theta_mean*pi/180-0.2, pi/2+theta_mean*pi/180+0.2] (L33), border lines via xline at both x-limits (L35-36) and yline at 0.0005 and 0 (L37), axis labels theta (rad) / E (m^2/rad) (L40-41), grid (L44-45), pbaspect [3 1 1] (L47), fontsize 24 (L48), saved as '1Dth_<Coherent_Percentage>p.png' (L50). ylim and Hmo title are commented out (L38, L43).

unresolved: cross-line defect candidate: Hmo_Syy1d_th (L28) sums Syy1d_th, which is initialized to zeros(1,mtheta) at L6 and never written afterwards — the computed Hmo is always 0; the integrated spectrum actually lives in Syy1d_th_unique (L19-27), and the only use of Hmo_Syy1d_th is the commented-out title (L43)
reps computed in L9-16 is never used elsewhere in this file

unit mix across arguments: theta/theta_unique are plotted in radians (L33, L40) while theta_mean is converted by *pi/180 (L33, L35, L36), implying degrees — conventions are defined by the caller, not this file
directional integration (L23-24) multiplies by scalar freq_resolution, assuming uniform frequency spacing; validity depends on the generator that built freq
